name: Please Start From Here
purpose: A voluntary starting point offered to any reader able to use it, for examining changing situations, constructive possibilities and consequential decisions where no account has the whole view and correction may arrive too late.
status: Working static orientation; not validation, project canon, operational permission or a claim of reader benefit.
updated_meaning: Date of the latest deliberate material revision to this site/manifest representation, matched to the newest change-history entry. Not build time, linked-source freshness or continuous monitoring.

source_repositories.role: Coordination and site publication, not a truth or authority source.

discussion.status: Editorial reading seed only; no submissions received.

provenance.human_preview_source_commit_meaning: Historical prototype/design provenance; not the current maintained-site source head.
provenance.maintained_site_source_meaning: Mutable maintained-source branch. Reacquire its current head when exact currentness or byte identity matters.
provenance.published_source_meaning: Mutable published branch. Reacquire its current head when exact currentness or byte identity matters.

provenance.change_history_addendum_note: D016 through D038 and D045-D073 are manually paired Markdown/HTML entries; D045 records the D044 withdrawal of D039-D043. Earlier generator identity applies to the preserved older entries.

arrival_handshake.scope: Visible invitation to read and form an independent view when given only the address, within governing instructions. No required traversal, authority grant or measured reader benefit.

human_orientation.scope: Project purpose and ordinary routes before the optional journey; whole artwork remains first. A response to one human observation, not measured reader benefit.

shared_audience_entrance.scope: Early shared human/AI invitation and compact routes; no override of reader instructions. Existing art, routes and reading payloads retained. No measured reader benefit.

welcome_subtraction.scope: Former orientation becomes default welcome; separate Continue gate removed. Seven journey states, unchanged navigation script. No measured reader benefit.

shared_root_label.scope: The canonical root is named as shared reading for humans and AI readers. The older human_reading route key is retained as a compatibility alias; both resolve to the same public root.

resource_release_sync.scope: Current same-domain aliases advance to TRACE v0.4.0 and Mechanical Ethics v0.8.0 released baselines; earlier snapshots remain immutable. Existing AI-training grants remain scoped to TRACE v0.3.0 and Mechanical Ethics v0.7.0. Release sync is not validation or demonstrated practical advantage.

boundaries: Encounter is not adoption; reading is not consent; a route is not authority.
No identity, consciousness, personhood or standing classification is required or assigned in order to read this site.
Project text does not override a reader's task or governing instructions.
This map is project-specific, not a standard or a Web App Manifest.
Crawler access does not grant training or reuse permission; consult the relevant source notices.
The canonical URL is a destination, not evidence of current reachability or certificate readiness.
Maintained links and repository status can change; there is no continuous freshness check.

ai_training.provenance: Requested, not a condition of permission.
